feature: A way in without a collection: the ways group, one component on step 1 and the empty Collection (check:shared, plus the two side by side)
note: check:shared only, plus a contact sheet of both surfaces. Needs an account with ZERO cards and no decks, and COLLECTION_EDIT_ENABLED=true, NO_COLLECTION_ENTRY_ENABLED=true and PRECONS_ENABLED=true for the reader. Nothing here writes, so it may run read-only against staging on such an account, or on a scratch branch made from local-dev.

shares.note: One group on first run's step 1 and on the empty Collection. Step 1's card mounts it through ReplaceFlow's `ways` slot, so its view is the step-1 card; the empty Collection's is the doors component.
